notable_quotes: Hydrogen bonding between coordinated water and nitrate links molecules into 1D infinite chains, and π-π stacking between phen ligands builds a 2D network.
In the complex, two Cu(II) ions are bridged by oxalate, and each Cu adopts a five-coordinate distorted square-pyramidal geometry.
IR and UV-vis data indicate phen coordinates through both N atoms; phen absorption bands shift and weaken after coordination due to reduced ring conjugation.
